items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And Lang would sit on my right side... And we called ourselves the Unholy Three. And man, we rocked that place

ctx.x: Suboivin Garden. 31. Yeah, you see. Well, he came back, well I had moved off Roma Street and I was living back in the block where John Casimir lived on Padida, between Johnson, I think, and Galvis. My family moved. And John, when Lully was out there, I had him to dedicate a couple of numbers to my mother, because they know that I was so crazy about him, copying his records all, you know, the whole time I was home, that's all I was doing. See, never got tired of blowing. See? And John Casimir, he'd come by my…
Fred ain't Lang the piano player now.
